Glucose meter

Juggluco will only add glucose values with a timestamp later than the specified date and time. Change to a later date and time if earlier glucose values are already present in Juggluco.

Select the label for blood glucose.

The first time you need to bring the glucose meter in PAIRING mode, for example by long pressing the button of the powered off meter until a blue light blinks.
